description: For a sponsor's Manage view: one sponsorship's GoldCoach record. Codes redeemed (when, and whether linked to a learner), the sponsor's agreement and package, and each learner's signal: only the milestones they shared, for learners of every age. Facts only: no conversation content and no person handle (learners are named by their order).

sponsorship_id.description: The sponsorship's id (SPN_...), as Manage shows it

name: coach_record_for_sponsorship

limits.description: What this answer could not do, each { code, statement }

package.description: The person's package with the interview; absent when the call could not use it

problem.description: When status is needs_attention: code, statement, what_to_do

record.description: agreement, codes_redeemed, learners (each with its signal), shared_with_sponsor

status.description: What happened, or needs_attention with a problem

title: Coach Record for a Sponsorship
